title: Bihar CM Samrat Choudhary Launches Live Classes For Schools, Free JEE-NEET Coaching Programme
description: Bihar CM Samrat Choudhary launched the ‘Bihar School Live Classes’ initiative and a free online JEE-NEET coaching programme in Patna. The initiative will connect schools with expert teachers through video conferencing, while the coaching programme has started in 10 model schools. The government also signed MoUs with NGOs to promote AI, STEM education and digital learning resources.
new_headline: Bihar’s Education Revolution: Free JEE-NEET Coaching and Live Classes Launched
new_summary: Big news for Bihar students! Deputy CM Samrat Choudhary has kicked off live virtual classes and free JEE-NEET coaching in state-run model schools. With new tech partnerships focused on AI and STEM, the government is leveling the playing field for aspirants across the state.
caption: Bihar is taking a massive leap in education! 🚀 With free JEE-NEET coaching and AI-driven virtual classes now live in state schools, the game is changing for every aspirant. Do you think this will bridge the gap for students in rural areas? Let us know your thoughts below! 📚
